title: Pool.pm Visual Explorer - Open Source Improved Reboot towards a sustainable community innovation platform

ms.promise: ・Visual explorer reworked homepage proof of concept
ms.criteria:
・PoC available publicly
・Last Cardano transactions must be displayed on homepage
・Realtime latency must be < 2 minutes
ms.report:
The new low-latency homepage proof of concept has been completed.
It can be checked on https://test.pool.pm as planned (please check after December 18 to be sure the deployment has been completed).
The proof of concept meets the acceptance criteria:
・It is available publicly
・Last block & transactions are displayed and their properties match other explorers (for example blocks TX number, total output & fees can be compared)
・Latency is less than 2 minutes old in average at any time (last block is less than 2 minutes old in average)

Note that once the new backend has replaced the old version, the link will redirect to https://pool.pm. This is expected.

ms.promise:
・Improved homepage
・Stake pool pages 
・Polished UX & UI
・Public Discord server launch
ms.criteria:
・Alpha version must be publicly available
・Homepage must display last Cardano transactions
・Pool pages must show pools statistics and delegators transactions
・Real-time latency must be less than 2 minutes
・Pages should not present major display or behavior bugs
ms.report:
A. Output: Improved homepage
Acceptance criteria: Alpha version must be publicly available. Homepage must display last Cardano transactions.
Evidence: https://alpha.pool.pm/
The homepage displays last Cardano transactions, and even shows transactions in the mempool before they are included in minted blocks.

B. Output: Stake pool pages
Acceptance criteria: Pool pages must show pools statistics and delegators transactions
Evidence:
・pool pages show the pool number of delegations, precise live stake updated instantly, as well as the pool parameters (pledge, margin, fixed cost)
・Pool pages can accessed by clicking a block pool ticker or by using the pool id in the URL (search is part of a future milestone)
・Recent pool delegators transactions and delegation changed are displayed and new ones appear in realtime, including in the mempool

Example: https://alpha.pool.pm/pool14wk2m2af7y4gk5uzlsmsunn7d9ppldvcxxa5an9r5ywek8330fg
Bonus: DReps feeds have also been implemented, for example:
https://alpha.pool.pm/drep1ydpfkyjxzeqvalf6fgvj7lznrk8kcmfnvy9hyl6gr6ez6wgsjaelx

C. Output: Polished UX & UI
Acceptance criteria: 
・It can be used on Mobile & Desktop
・Real-time latency must be less than 2 minutes
・Pages should not present major display or behavior bugs

Evidence: https://alpha.pool.pm/
・the alpha version now runs in true realtime without any latency (blocks appear as soon as minted)
・the mempool is displayed in realtime
・slots are represented by blocks moving every second
・UI is smooth with animations to show how blocks are minted from the mempool then chained
・the website uses a responsive design and works on mobile and desktop
・no major bug is present

D. Output: Public Discord server launch
Acceptance criteria: Discord server is publicly available with a channel available to discuss the version
Evidence: https://discord.pool.pm (with #alpha.pool.pm channel to report alpha issues)

ms.criteria:
・Testnet "preview" network version must be publicly available at https://preview.pool.pm
・Homepage must display last Cardano preview network transactions

ms.report:
A. Output: Preview network support
Acceptance criteria: 
・Testnet "preview" network version must be publicly available at https://preview.pool.pm
・Homepage must display last Cardano preview network transactions
・Pool pages must show preview network pools statistics and delegators transactions
・Realtime latency must be less than 2 minutes

Evidence: https://preview.pool.pm
・preview version is available online
・homepage shows transactions in realtime
・pool pages can be accessed by clicking a block pool ticker or from URL https://preview.pool.pm/POOL_ID, for example https://preview.pool.pm/pool1q65ag8panwayzaqfs6je7jz2ywt8x2032yaunq5hf25t7t8c26e
・pool pages show the pool precise live stake in realtime, as well as the number of delegators and the pool parameters (pledge, margin, fixed cost)
・the service runs in true realtime. Blocks are displayed as soon as they are minted, and transactions are shown in the mempool even before they are included in blocks
・performance is on par with mainnet alpha version (https://alpha.pool.pm)

ms.promise:
・Search bar 
・Assets timeline pages (minted & transferred NFTs & Fungible tokens)
・Stake address pages (Stake address transactions & rewards timeline, assets list)
・Single asset pages (Token viewer)
ms.criteria:
・It must be possible to search stake pools, addresses, assets fingerprints and policies
・Stake addresses & tokens transactions must be displayed less than 2 minutes after their propagation
・Stake addresses timelines must include transactions and rewards
・Asset policies pages must display all assets (with scrolling)
ms.report:
A. Output: Search bar

Acceptance criteria: It must be possible to search stake pools, addresses, assets fingerprints and policies.

Evidence: 
- go to https://beta.pool.pm
- click the top right search icon
- enter in the search bar bech32 stake pool addresses, addr1 and stake1 addresses, asset1 fingerprints and policy hex values. The corresponding page should be displayed. For example:
 
stake pool: pool14wk2m2af7y4gk5uzlsmsunn7d9ppldvcxxa5an9r5ywek8330fg
stake address: stake1uxmhvxe0d632mdzu2u773c69wwqz7srv8dmdmh4lzxn30kgw29wph
base address: addr1qy5s8gar44dnstwsvxkxuzap4wmlul2tn296f96h79qsen4hwcdj7m4z4k69c4eaar352uuq9aqxcwmkmh0t7yd8zlvswsr386
fingerprint: asset1a39s8ugsy80gd0g3zt5tdy4n8nerspyccwd8au
policy: d5e6bf0500378d4f0da4e8dde6becec7621cd8cbf5cbb9b87013d4cc

bonus: DRep addresses are also supported, for example enter:
drep1yglrf4el8gghum239fggvfrau25k2576y4dvcz65r2ukj8sqpsc2k

B. Output: Assets timeline pages (minted & transferred NFTs & Fungible tokens)

Acceptance criteria: Stake addresses & tokens transactions must be displayed less than 2 minutes after their propagation

Evidence: Minted and transfered tokens (NFTs and fungible) are now displayed on the main timeline in this version, so there is no specific asset timeline anymore like in legacy pool.pm. 

So go to https://beta.pool.pm
- check that transactions are displayed in realtime (and therefore less than 2 mins old)
- check that assets (images) are displayed

C. Output: Stake address pages (Stake address transactions & rewards timeline, assets list)

Acceptance criteria: Stake addresses timelines must include transactions and rewards

Evidence: Search on https://beta.pool.pm some stake address that received some rewards, for example:
stake1u9rlucxzctavnf826303mn6zf9jxxpve8qfa66z0pdutzfgv6vqlx

- the timeline include all transactions
- current available rewards are displayed in the info header circle
- clicking the ASSETS link in the info header circle display all the address assets

D. Output: Sin
